question: Does the FY2027 consensus residual prove a lower-bound revenue beat under the existing operating policy?
verdict: NO unconditional lower-bound beat. YES exact residual/headroom comparison. Products is external revenue; the $2.8B All Other forecast is segment revenue with unspecified future internal-sales elimination. The model capital denominator omits shadow packaging and legacy external Foundry sales.

source_scope.facts: Products is external-customer revenue. Foundry has internal and external sales. All Other can include intersegment sales. Segment revenue is reconciled with separate revenue eliminations.

source_scope.locator: Financial Forecast: Revenue Next Year $69.27B; fiscal-year table FY2027; Data Sources and Last Updated lines235-239
source_scope.facts: FY2027 consolidated revenue proxy $69.27B. No publicly visible Products or CPU consensus. Contributor count and individual forecast vintages for FY2027 unavailable.

policy_locators.scope: Segment revenue; the adjacent zero intersegment_operating_elimination_B is operating profit, not revenue.
Host already reserves packaging economics; add net incremental sales only to its capital proxy, not a full consolidated revenue forecast.
Current Products68.3326878; Other2.8; gross packaging.5; shadow packaging.25; capital proxy71.3826878. Independently checked accounting against primary10-Q.

consolidation_identity.unknown_variables: L=legacy external Foundry sales excluding gross packaging G; I=All Other internal revenue eliminated on consolidation. Neither annual series is owned by current model.
consolidation_identity.formula: Consolidated revenue = P + O + G + L - I = 71.6326878 + L - I.
consolidation_identity.from_capital_proxy: Consolidated revenue = capital proxy71.3826878 + shadow packaging.25 + L - I.
consolidation_identity.no_packaging_headroom: External Foundry + net All Other must equal0.9373122 to coexist with Products68.3326878 and total69.27.
consolidation_identity.what_would_erase_gap: With gross packaging.5 and L>=0, consensus requires I>=2.3626878+L (84.38% of the2.8 Other forecast before any L), or net All Other<=.4373122-L. Historical elimination is much smaller, but not a forward upper bound.
consolidation_identity.mathematical_lower_bound: Even accepting gross packaging.5 and only requiring net All Other>=0 and L>=0, lower bound P+G=68.8326878 remains below69.27. Therefore an unconditional positive beat is not proved.
consolidation_identity.conditional_lower_bound: If a new explicit policy defines net All Other external revenue as2.8 and L>=0, then P+net Other already exceeds consensus by1.8626878; including G gives2.3626878. Current policy does not separately define that net series. Adopting it would be a forecast decision, not a source fact.

interpretation: The clean residual does establish that this Products forecast leaves little space inside the total consensus proxy for external non-Products businesses.
It cannot establish that consensus specifically underestimates server CPUs: consensus may differ on PCs, CPU ASP, Other DCAI, Mobileye/IMS or external Foundry.
The consensus proxy is a survey estimate, not a market-implied forecast or evidence that all estimates postdate Intel results.
Do not add internal Foundry revenue, double-count gross and net packaging, or use zero operating-profit elimination as zero revenue elimination.
Do not annualize Q3 external Foundry411M as recurring legacy revenue: Intel says the quarter was boosted primarily by a nonrecurring contract.
safest_main_slide_wording: My $68.3B Products forecast leaves only $0.94B within the $69.3B 2027 total-revenue consensus proxy for external Foundry and net All Other.
safest_short_footnote: S&P Global via StockAnalysis, updated Nov5. Products is external sales; this is a residual comparison, not a fully reconciled consolidated revenue beat.
optional_explanatory_line: My separate $2.8B All Other segment assumption exceeds that residual before eliminating internal sales; future eliminations and legacy Foundry sales are not forecast.
rejected_wording: Consensus misses Intel server demand by$1.86B.
Gross packaging.5 is wholly incremental to the existing capital proxy.
actions: No forecast/model/builder/PDF edits. No new external Foundry or Other-internal forecast supplied.
